skill.name: seo-snippet-hunter
skill.description: Formats question-based content for featured snippets and related search features using concise paragraphs, lists, tables, and structured answer blocks.
skill.summary: Create concise, structured answers designed for featured snippet eligibility.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: Both static findings are false positives caused by Markdown syntax. The skill contains content-formatting guidance and no executable commands or malicious instructions.

static_findings.snippet: - If detailed examples are required, open `resources/implementation-playbook.md`.

finding_verdicts.reason: Line 24 uses backticks only to format a relative documentation path in Markdown. It contains no shell command or execution instruction.
Lines 80 through 89 are a fenced Markdown output template. The backticks delimit example content and do not execute a command.

content.value_statement: Question-based content often lacks the structure needed for featured snippet eligibility. This skill creates concise answer blocks, lists, tables, and format recommendations.
actual_capabilities: Identifies questions within supplied content and selects suitable snippet formats.
Creates direct paragraph answers within a recommended 40 to 60 word range.
Formats processes as numbered steps and features as concise bullet lists.
Structures comparison information as clean tables.
Produces People Also Ask question and answer pairs.
Suggests FAQPage, HowTo, placement, and supporting content strategies.
limitations: It cannot guarantee a featured snippet or search ranking.
It does not perform live SERP research without separate browsing tools and current search data.
It requires source content, target questions, or accurate facts from the user.
Structured data suggestions require technical validation before publication.

use_cases.title: Refresh Editorial Content
use_cases.description: Convert existing article sections into direct answers, lists, and tables for relevant search questions.

use_cases.title: Plan Search Briefs
use_cases.description: Create snippet targets, People Also Ask questions, and recommended formats for a new content brief.

use_cases.title: Structure Product Comparisons
use_cases.description: Turn verified product details into concise comparison tables and supporting answers.

prompt_templates.title: Create One Snippet
prompt_templates.prompt: Rewrite this answer for the question: [question]. Use 40 to 60 words and place the main answer first. Content: [content].

prompt_templates.title: Choose the Best Format
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this content for [target question]. Choose a paragraph, list, or table format. Explain the choice, then provide the optimized block.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Snippet Package
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a snippet package from this article: [article]. Include one direct answer, one list, related questions, and placement recommendations.

prompt_templates.title: Develop an Advanced Search Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze these target questions and verified competitor notes: [inputs]. Create varied snippet blocks, supporting sections, internal jump links, and schema recommendations.

output_examples.input: Question: What is a featured snippet? Source: A short explanation of the search result feature.
output_examples.output:
What is a featured snippet?

A featured snippet is a concise answer shown above standard organic results. It can appear as a paragraph, list, table, or video result.

output_examples.input: Convert a five-stage content audit into a list snippet.
output: Place the revised answer near the relevant heading.

output_examples.input: Recommend a format for comparing three service plans.
output_examples.output: Recommended format: a table. Use plans as columns and verified features as rows, followed by a short explanation of the main differences.

best_practices: Provide the exact target question, verified facts, and intended audience.
Keep the direct answer near its matching question heading.
Review accuracy, search intent, readability, and structured data before publishing.
anti_patterns: Do not add unsupported claims or invent competitor information.
Do not repeat keywords when natural language answers the question clearly.
Do not treat formatting as a guarantee of rankings or snippet placement.

faq.question: What content can this skill optimize?
faq.answer: It can optimize supplied articles, definitions, procedures, comparisons, and frequently asked questions.

faq.question: Does it guarantee a featured snippet?
faq.answer: No. Search engines control selection, and rankings depend on authority, relevance, accuracy, competition, and technical factors.

faq.question: Which snippet formats does it support?
faq.answer: It supports concise paragraphs, numbered steps, bullet lists, comparison tables, and related question answers.

faq.question: Can it research current search results?
faq.answer: Not by itself. Provide current SERP observations or use separate browsing tools when live research is required.

faq.question: Can it generate structured data?
faq.answer: It can suggest FAQPage and HowTo structures, but the final markup requires implementation and validation.

faq.question: What inputs produce the best results?
faq.answer: Provide the exact question, source content, verified facts, audience, target terms, and any current competitor observations.
